questions.q: What is a Power BI semantic model?
options: The published, modeled version of your data — tables, relationships, and measures — ready for reports to be built from, formerly called a 'dataset'
A raw, uncleaned copy of the original source tables
A single visual on a report page
A feature only available in Power BI Desktop, never the service
questions.explain: A semantic model is the 'ready for reporting' shape of your data — the modeled, related, measure-bearing version, treated as its own first-class object separate from any one report.

questions.q: What is the key tradeoff of Import mode compared to DirectQuery?
options: Import copies data into memory for fast queries but needs a refresh to stay current; DirectQuery is always current but queries the source live and is slower
Import is always slower than DirectQuery in every scenario
DirectQuery copies all data into memory, exactly like Import
There is no difference between the two modes
questions.explain: Import trades currency for speed (data is copied, so it's fast, but needs refresh). DirectQuery trades speed for currency (no copy, so it's always current, but depends on live source connectivity).

questions.q: What does a Composite mode semantic model do?
options: Mixes Import and DirectQuery within the same model, with some tables imported and others queried live
Combines two entirely separate Power BI files into one report
Is only available for streaming semantic models
Requires every table to use the same storage mode
questions.explain: Composite mode lets a modeler choose per-table: some tables Import for speed, others DirectQuery for currency, within a single semantic model.

questions.q: What does a live connection to an externally hosted Analysis Services model do?
options: It passes queries straight through to the externally hosted model instead of importing any data into Power BI
It copies the entire external model into Power BI's own storage
It only works with Power BI Desktop, never the service
It requires rebuilding the entire model from scratch in Power BI
questions.explain: A live-connection semantic model holds no data of its own — every query is passed through to the externally hosted Analysis Services model, letting Power BI sit on top of an existing investment without duplicating it.

questions.q: What is the difference between dynamic and static row-level security (RLS) roles?
options: Dynamic roles filter based on who is viewing the report; static roles apply the same fixed filter to everyone assigned to that role
Dynamic roles only work in DirectQuery mode; static roles only work in Import mode
There is no functional difference between them
Static roles change automatically every 24 hours
questions.explain: A dynamic RLS role adapts its filter to the identity of the person viewing the report, while a static role applies one unchanging filter to every user assigned to it.
